title: What the Multi-Tenant Portal partner account settings hold: white labeling and logo, SAML SSO certificates and URLs, domains, partner support and password reset

prose.text: {{settings-page-info}} The values of Partner Type are not listed {{gap:partner-type-values}}. {{domains}}

prose.label: White labeling.
prose.text: {{white-label-items}} {{logo-limits}} {{logout-url}} Whether white labeling covers the ZIA Admin Portal alone or the tenants' admin portals generally differs by page {{divergence:white-label-scope}}.

prose.label: Single sign-on.
prose.text: {{sso-tenant-zia}} {{sso-tenant-zia-urls}} The IdP-initiated workflow names a different ACS URL target {{divergence:tenant-zia-acs-url}}. {{sso-portal}} {{sso-portal-urls}} {{idp-initiated}}

settings-page-info.statement: The Settings page shows the Partner ID generated when the account was created with Zscaler, the account status, and the Partner Type (the type of partner account).

quotes: Partner ID: The ID generated when you created your account with Zscaler.
The status of your account.
Partner Type: The type of partner account.

logo-limits.statement: An account logo must be 300 x 220 pixels or less, 10 KB or less, and a .png, .jpg or .gif file; the logo is used to white label the tenants' ZIA Admin Portal if white labeling is enabled.

quotes: Dimensions of 300 x 220 pixels or less.
Size of 10 KB or less.
.png, .jpg, or .gif file types.
Your partner account logo is used for white labeling your tenant's ZIA Admin Portal if you've enabled white labeling.

white-label-items.statement: Enabling White Labeling white labels the tenants' Admin Portals; the items the partner can white label are Partner Support, Partner CSS Color Scheme (Magenta), Partner UI Logout URL, Account Logo and Background Color.

quotes: White Labeling: Enable this to white label the Admin Portals of your tenant accounts.
Partner Support
Partner CSS Color Scheme (Magenta)
Partner UI Logout URL
Account Logo
Background Color
evidence.after: White Labeling: Enable this to white label the Admin Portals of your tenant accounts.

logout-url.statement: The Partner UI Logout URL is the URL that tenants see when they log out of the ZIA Admin Portal, and it is only available for white-labeled partners.

quotes: Partner UI Logout URL: Enter the URL that the tenants see when they log out of the ZIA Admin Portal.
This option is only available for white-labeled partners.

sso-tenant-zia.statement: SSO to the tenants' ZIA Admin Portal requires an SSO certificate from the partner's SAML service provider; the uploaded certificate is the public key extracted from it, as a binary-encoded DER file with a .der extension and no other periods in the file name.

quotes: SSO to Tenants' ZIA Admin Portal: Enable Single Sign-On (SSO) to log in to the tenants' ZIA Admin Portal. You must obtain the SSO certificate from your SAML service provider before enabling this option.

Certificate (.der): Extract and upload the public key from the SSO certificate provided by your SAML service provider. Ensure that the key is binary-encoded using a Distinguished Encoding Rules (DER) file before you upload it. The file extension must be .der and should not have other periods (.) in the file name.

sso-tenant-zia-urls.statement: The page lists, for SSO to the tenants' ZIA Admin Portal, the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL https://admin.<Cloud_Name>/ssologin.do and the Entity ID https://admin.<Cloud_Name>.

quotes: Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL/Destination URL: https://admin.<Cloud_Name>/ssologin.do
Entity ID: https://admin.<Cloud_Name>

sso-portal.statement: SSO to the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners requires an SSO certificate from the partner's SAML service provider; the uploaded certificate is a Base64-encoded PEM file with a .pem extension and no other periods in the file name.

quotes: SSO to Management Portal for Partners: Enable SSO to log in to the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners. You must obtain the SSO certificate from your SAML service provider before enabling this option.

Certificate (.pem): Upload the SSL public certificate that is used to verify the digital signature of the identity provider (IdP). This is the Base64-encoded PEM format certificate that you downloaded from your IdP. The file extension must be .pem and have no other periods (.) in the file name.

sso-portal-urls.statement: For SSO to the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners the ACS URL is https://partners.zscalerscm.net/partnersso.do (depending on the IdP used), and Zscaler recommends https://partners.zscalerscm.net/ as a default value for the Entity ID, though any value unique to a customer or partner IdP can be used.

quotes: Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL/Destination URL (Depends on the IdP used (i.e., Okta or Azure)): https://partners.zscalerscm.net/partnersso.do.
Entity ID: As a default value, Zscaler recommends using https://partners.zscalerscm.net/, or you can use any value that is unique to a customer or partner IdP.

idp-initiated.statement: The Multi-Tenant Portal supports IdP-initiated SSO, in which access and authentication take place through the partner's IdP portal.

quotes: The Multi-Tenant Portal supports IdP-initiated Single Sign-On for which the access and authentication take place through the partner's IdP portal.

domains.statement: The Internal Domain field shows the domain generated when creating the partner account, a default domain for the partner's first login; a partner can have a maximum of 16 partner domains, and changing or adding a partner domain requires Zscaler Support.

quotes: Internal Domain: This field shows your internal domain generated when creating your partner account. It is a default domain created for the partner to log in for the first time.
A partner can have a maximum of 16 domains. Contact Zscaler Support to change or add a partner domain.

partner-support.statement: The Partner Support setting selects the support type tenants see in their Admin Portals, with a support email address if Email is selected or a support website URL if Portal URL is selected.

quotes: Partner Support: Select the support type for your account. Tenants can view this support information in their Admin Portals.
Partner Support Email: If you select Email as the partner support, enter your support email address.
Partner Support URL: If you select Portal URL as the partner support, enter your support website URL.

password-reset.statement: Reset Password and Send Activation Email resets the default admin account password and sends a reset link; multiple Activation Email Recipients can be entered, and for partners migrated to Authentication Service the Reset Password feature moves under Administration in the Authentication Service Admin Portal.

quotes: Reset Password and Send Activation Email: Select this option to reset your default admin account password. You receive the password reset email link.
Activation Email Recipient: Enter the email recipient to receive the password reset link. You can enter multiple recipients.
For partners who have migrated to Authentication Service, the Reset Password feature moves under Administration in the Authentication Service Admin Portal.

subscription-agreement.statement: The End User Subscription Agreement selected in settings can be viewed as a notification for the partner's customers when logging in to the ZIA Admin Portal.

quotes: You can view the selected end user subscription agreement notification for your customers when you log in to the ZIA Admin Portal.

white-label-scope.summary: The logo page ties the partner account logo to the tenant's ZIA Admin Portal, while the account settings page and Tenant Details page describe white labeling across the tenants' Admin Portals.

positions.says: The partner account logo is used for white labeling the tenant's ZIA Admin Portal.

quotes: Your partner account logo is used for white labeling your tenant's ZIA Admin Portal if you've enabled white labeling.

positions.says: White Labeling white labels the Admin Portals of the partner's tenant accounts.

quotes: White Labeling: Enable this to white label the Admin Portals of your tenant accounts.

positions.says: Show Partner Logo indicates whether the partner logo is enabled in the admin portals the tenant has access to.

quotes: Show Partner Logo: This is a white labeling feature that indicates if the partner logo is enabled or disabled in the admin portals the tenant has access to.

white-label-scope.impact: Whether the logo and Partner UI Logout URL appear in tenant admin portals other than the ZIA Admin Portal is not stated.

tenant-zia-acs-url.summary: The SSO to Tenants' ZIA Admin Portal settings give the ACS URL as https://admin.<Cloud_Name>/ssologin.do, while the IdP-initiated workflow for the same SSO sends the assertion to the Partner Portal ACS URL.

positions.says: The ACS URL/Destination URL is https://admin.<Cloud_Name>/ssologin.do.

quotes: Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL/Destination URL: https://admin.<Cloud_Name>/ssologin.do

positions.says: In the IdP-initiated workflow the browser sends the SAML assertion to the Partner Portal ACS URL.

quotes: The browser sends a SAML message containing an assertion to the Partner Portal ACS URL.

tenant-zia-acs-url.impact: The page does not say whether the IdP-initiated tile posts to the ssologin.do URL or to the partners portal ACS URL.

partner-type-values.title: What values Partner Type takes
partner-type-values.detail: The account settings article describes Partner Type only as the type of partner account and does not list its values or what each changes.
